# NeuralNexus — no required secrets

Since sign-in was switched to a locally-generated private key (see
components/UnlockPanel.tsx and lib/keyClient.ts), the server holds:
  - the private key's SHA-256 hash (not the key itself), and
  - an HMAC signature for the session cookie (server-side, not the key).

The app is intended to run on a single local device / user, so there
are no GitHub OAuth App credentials, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, or external
provider tokens required anymore.

The only env vars you may set:

  DATABASE_URL        where the SQLite file lives (local dev: file:…/data/dev.db)
  NN_SESSION_SECRET   (optional) override the local-only secret used to
                      sign /api/auth/login's session cookie. Leave unset
                      for the built-in insecure local default.
  NN_COOKIE_INSECURE  (optional) set to "1" to allow the session cookie
                      to be sent over plain http on non-localhost
                      deployments. Default: cookies are Secure-only.
  NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED  "1" — recommended, off by default.

If you add a deployment, also consider:
  - A real HTTPS front-end (reverse proxy / Caddy / nginx) so the
    session cookie can be sent Secure.
  - `NN_SESSION_SECRET` set to a random long string (openssl rand -hex 32).
  - A firewall so port 3000 is only reachable where you expect it.

No more GitHub App IDs, OAuth secrets, or external tokens.
